translations.選取後立即套用；只影響管理器介面: Applied immediately; affects only the manager UI
translations.輸入伺服器指令，例如 players、servermsg 訊息: Enter a server command, such as players or servermsg message
translations.修復：UTF-8 曾被 Big5 誤讀後存檔: Repair: UTF-8 was misread and saved as Big5
translations.B42 Stable 留空；測試版使用 unstable: Leave blank for B42 Stable; use unstable for the test branch
translations.列在公開伺服器清單: List in the public server browser
translations.允許新玩家直接加入: Allow new players to join directly
translations.儲存管理器設定並寫入伺服器 INI: Save manager settings and write server INI
translations.允許玩家互相傷害（PVP）: Allow players to damage each other (PVP)
translations.玩家會疲勞且必須睡覺: Players become tired and must sleep
translations.玩家加入歡迎訊息（不預填；用 <LINE> 換行）: Player welcome message (not prefilled; use <LINE> for a new line)
translations.明確套用 B42 範例：球棒＋水＋巧克力: Apply B42 example: bat + water + chocolate
translations.啟用遊戲內建 StarterKit（額外背包、球棒等；通常不建議與自訂出生物品同: Enable the built-in StarterKit (extra bag, bat, etc.; usually not recommended with custom spawn items)
translations.管理器不會自動增加、刪除或替換物品 ID。: The manager never adds, removes, or replaces item IDs automatically.
translations.注意：Build 42 原生 SpawnItems 套用於每次建立新角色，包含死: Note: Build 42 SpawnItems apply whenever a new character is created, including after death; first-spawn and respawn items cannot be configured separately.
translations.B42 使用 0.00–4.00 小數倍率；數值越高，物資越多。: B42 uses decimal multipliers from 0.00–4.00; higher values produce more loot.
translations.向全服公告玩家死亡: Announce player deaths to the server
translations.地圖玩家可見度（官方預設：隱藏）: Remote player visibility on map (official default: hidden)
translations.允許新角色在上一個角色死亡位置重生: Allow a new character to respawn at the previous character's death location
translations.允許分割畫面／Remote Play 玩家在其他本機角色旁重生: Allow split-screen / Remote Play players to respawn beside another local character
translations.下載順序不等於載入順序；管理器會選取目前 B42 版本、檢查硬依賴／作者排序／互: Download order is not load order. The manager selects the current B42 variant, checks hard dependencies, author ordering and mutually exclusive options, then builds Mods from the checked order below.
translations.加入勾選候選（尚未下載／寫入）: Add checked candidates (not downloaded or written yet)
translations.Steam 頁面宣告的依賴候選（不會自動加入）: Dependency candidates declared by Steam pages (not added automatically)
translations.Steam Required Items 可能包含可選功能；請自行判斷。: Steam Required Items may include optional features; review them yourself.
translations.套用勾選與順序（尚未寫入 INI）: Apply checked items and order (not written to INI yet)
translations.套用地圖與重生點（尚未寫入）: Apply maps and spawn points (not written yet)
translations.分號分隔；自訂地圖通常需放在 Muldraugh, KY 前面: Separate with semicolons; custom maps usually need to precede Muldraugh, KY
translations.只有找到 spawnpoints.lua 的地圖才能加入角色建立重生選單；勾選後: Only maps containing spawnpoints.lua can be added to the character creation spawn menu. When explicitly saved, checked entries are written to a manager-marked block in _spawnregions.lua; all other existing content is preserved. Client-side allowlist assessment is for review only, and DoLuaChecksum remains true.
translations.支援未來 42.x 新增欄位；請在伺服器停止時編輯。: Supports future 42.x fields; edit only while the server is stopped.
translations.伺服器啟動後會反灰；允許 1–1440 分鐘: Locked after the server starts; allowed range 1–1440 minutes
translations.倒數公告（{minutes} 會代入剩餘分鐘）: Countdown announcement ({minutes} is replaced with minutes remaining)
translations.重啟前建立 ZIP 備份: Create a ZIP backup before restart
translations.流程：遊戲內倒數公告 → save → ZIP 備份 → quit → 等候程序: Flow: in-game countdown → save → ZIP backup → quit → wait for process exit → start again. The schedule begins after the server starts successfully.
translations.尚未找到 steamcmd.exe。你可以選擇既有檔案，或由管理器從 Valve: steamcmd.exe was not found. Select an existing file or let the manager download and extract it from Valve's official source. Server settings remain hidden and untouched until this is complete.
translations.SteamCMD 已就緒。選擇 Dedicated Server 安裝位置後執行: SteamCMD is ready. Choose the Dedicated Server installation path and install it. Management and settings are unlocked only after a server launch script is found.
translations.從 Valve 下載並安裝 SteamCMD: Download and install SteamCMD from Valve
translations.作業執行中，請勿關閉管理器。: Operation in progress. Do not close the manager.
